summary: BP p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K reporting its total voting rights and share capital as of May 31, 2026. The filing states the company has 15,702,499,904 ordinary shares (par $0.25, one vote each) and 12,706,252 preference shares (par £1, two votes per £5 held). Treasury shares total 783,813,090. The total voting rights are 15,707,582,404. This is a routine disclosure under UK FCA rules, not a special situation.
